pull_request.body:
The expanded canonical Home document requires IsDashboard, IsLibrary and IsEvents. The standalone host supplied only summary bindings, so loading Home.cui failed with CUIR011 and displayed the fallback screen. Project the three values from the existing Home controller surface into the native host's existing view model.

Keep all six original tests and their lifetime, rendering, accessibility, source, action, fallback, fault and theme assertions. Correct the synchronous capacity-exhaustion assertion's accidental Func<Task> overload; provide canonical route values in the missing/faulted binding fixtures; bind nav-settings to its actual current source line 19; and observe the current rendered status control after asynchronous refresh. The original failed runs and a diagnostic showing the stale control versus the correctly updated current control are preserved in the recovery evidence.

Validation on fa7db1bd plus exactly this three-file delta, Windows/.NET SDK 10.0.401: source-built CUI task and full Home Release build succeed with zero warnings/errors; all six original cases execute and pass, zero failed/skipped. An independent reviewer checked every hunk and the original/final six test identities and raw TRX. GitHub commit readback confirms only the reviewed three files changed.

This is a reviewed isolated proposal for Team C composition. Installed Home/runtime authority, signing, clean no-SDK Windows acceptance, graphical package verification, delivery and broader 30-app release acceptance remain open. Lifecycle and authorization code are unchanged.
